narration: Rain spatters the soot-dark stone, while frayed banners flutter above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors, providing a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor around it. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke tightly as the crowd presses in. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers linger along the muddy gate line, watching quietly. A notice board nearby lists new taxes, curfew rules, and a posted warning about a missing patrol. The rain barrel by the gate hosts a tavern runner loudly hawking hot stew and paid rumor. A gate serjeant maintains control over the crowd, keeping a vigilant eye on the roster board as the ash compact census delays tighten the eastern caravan choke point. Among the gathered figures, one in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, their gaze flicking over packs and faces more than to the gate queue itself.
